people.name: Mr. Rakesh Thakur
people.role: Chief Financial Officer (CFO) & Key Managerial Personnel (KMP)
people.evidence_quote: has inter -alia considered and approved the appointment of Mr. Rakesh Thakur, as the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) & Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company with immediate effect.
people.bio_quote: Mr. Rakesh Thakur, aged 49 years, is a Chartered Accountant with over 22 years of professional experience across leading consumer and multinational organisations. Prior to joining Campus Activewear Limited, he served as the Group Chief Financial Officer of Imagine Marketing Limited (boAt), where he worked closely with the founders, CEO, Board and leadership team and played a key role in driving the Company’s financial and strategic agenda.
